mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lotto_result (draw_no, draw_date, no1, no2, no3, no4, no5, no6, bonus_no) VALUES (#{drawNo}, #{drawDate}, #{no1}, #{no2}, #{no3}, #{no4}, #{no5}, #{no6}, #{bonusNo}) ON CONFLICT (draw_no) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT draw_no AS drawNo, draw_date AS drawDate, no1, no2, no3, no4, no5, no6, bonus_no AS bonusNo, created_at AS createdAt FROM lotto_result WHERE draw_no = #{drawNo}
SELECT draw_no AS drawNo, draw_date AS drawDate, no1, no2, no3, no4, no5, no6, bonus_no AS bonusNo, created_at AS createdAt FROM lotto_result ORDER BY draw_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT draw_no AS drawNo, draw_date AS drawDate, no1, no2, no3, no4, no5, no6, bonus_no AS bonusNo, created_at AS createdAt FROM lotto_result ORDER BY draw_no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lotto_analysis_pool (draw_no, strategy, pool_numbers, combos) VALUES (#{drawNo}, #{strategy}, #{poolNumbers, typeHandler=com.marketpulse.domain.lotto.mapper.IntArrayTypeHandler}::integer[], #{combos}::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (draw_no, strategy) DO UPDATE SET pool_numbers = EXCLUDED.pool_numbers, combos = EXCLUDED.combos
mapper.select: SELECT id, draw_no AS drawNo, strategy, pool_numbers AS poolNumbers, combos::text AS combos, created_at AS createdAt FROM lotto_analysis_pool WHERE draw_no = #{drawNo} ORDER BY strategy
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lotto_analysis_result (draw_no, strategy, pool_hit_count, combo_results) VALUES (#{drawNo}, #{strategy}, #{poolHitCount}, #{comboResults}::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (draw_no, strategy) DO UPDATE SET pool_hit_count = EXCLUDED.pool_hit_count, combo_results = EXCLUDED.combo_results
mapper.select: SELECT id, draw_no AS drawNo, strategy, pool_hit_count AS poolHitCount, combo_results::text AS comboResults, created_at AS createdAt FROM lotto_analysis_result WHERE draw_no = #{drawNo}
SELECT id, draw_no AS drawNo, strategy, pool_hit_count AS poolHitCount, combo_results::text AS comboResults, created_at AS createdAt FROM lotto_analysis_result ORDER BY draw_no DESC
SELECT id, draw_no AS drawNo, numbers, hit_count AS hitCount, created_at AS createdAt FROM lotto_user_combo ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE lotto_user_combo SET hit_count = #{hitCount} WHERE id = #{id}
